args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and immediately began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. As remediation, the service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed and the service is now confirmed healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with error rate back to 0.2%. v2.3.1 (and its staging predecessor v2.3.1-rc) require investigation before any re-deploy.
